title: Qualcomm Is Cheap Enough to Hold Through 2030
description: Qualcomm stock has fallen by 33% from its high, and now trades at just a single-digit multiple of management's fiscal 2029 earnings target.

title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet to Let AI Agents Shop—Without Crypto
description: OpenAI’s new wallet lets AI agents buy products using ordinary cards, challenging crypto payment tools from Coinbase and Circle as companies compete to control everyday online shopping by autonomous software.

title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million. ]]>

title: DTCC, Barclays Say Tokenization's Real Prize Is Unlocking Idle Collateral
description: Executives from the U.S. settlement giant and Barclays told Solana's Breakpoint that adoption is early, but accelerating.

title: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
description: Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US. ]]>

title: Binance Hack Wallets Move $137 Million in Ethereum After Two Weeks of Silence
description: A wallet linked to October’s record Binance theft moved $63 million in ether, before analysts flagged a larger wave of transfers and reported Bitcoin swaps amid ongoing U.S. recovery efforts.

title: Nvidia Board Shuts Down Jensen Huang Comeback, Launches Search for New CEO
description: Nvidia's board rejected a comeback for its ousted co-founder as it hired a search firm, backed interim CEO Colette Kress, and tightened oversight of chip exports to China.
